changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.amo_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), action TEXT, status TEXT, user_id TEXT, phone TEXT, amo_contact_id BIGINT, request TEXT, response TEXT, error_message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_amo_log_created_at ON integration.amo_log (created_at DESC);
